title: Guard Door (Normally Closed)
story: Safety convention: In industrial control, emergency stops and guard switches are wired Normally Closed (NC), meaning the bit is 1 when safe/closed, and 0 when opened. Wire an XIO contact to sound the buzzer when the door opens.
concept: An XIO contact (Normally Closed) passes power when its bit is 0. Field wiring and logic are distinct: a physical closed door sends bit 1, so XIO turns off the buzzer.

learn.title: The Normally Closed (NC) Convention
learn.text: Fail-safe wiring uses NC contacts: if a wire breaks, the bit drops to 0 immediately. XIO conducts when the bit is 0 (door opened).

tests.name: Buzzer sounds only when door is open

steps.explanation: Door is closed (bit 1) -> Buzzer must be SILENT.
Door closed again (bit 1) -> Buzzer turns OFF.

hints: Use the XIO contact for DOOR.
Wire Rail L to sw1:in, sw1:out to buzzer1:in, and buzzer1:out to Rail R.
When DOOR is 0, the XIO contact conducts power through to the buzzer.
